address: 11155 Red Run Blvd., Suite 200, Owings Mills, MD 21117

reading.body:
At 2.3 MW of published IT capacity across 22,000 square feet of technical space, this campus is small by AI infrastructure standards. Assuming 40 kW per rack, a common density for AI training workloads, 2.3 MW supports roughly 57 racks. At 8 GPUs per rack, that is approximately 456 accelerator slots, though neither figure is the operator's claim and actual density depends on the workloads colocated here. The campus is sized for enterprise colocation rather than hyperscale AI training.

The three certifications narrow what this campus is qualified to host. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card data environments. HIPAA and HITRUST together qualify it for regulated healthcare workloads, with HITRUST representing a third-party-validated control framework layered on top of HIPAA's baseline requirements. The certification profile points toward compliance-sensitive enterprise tenants rather than large-scale model training.

Within Maryland, this campus ranks first by published IT capacity, but that ranking reflects a thin data set: only 2 of the 11 facilities mapped in the state publish a megawatt figure, and those 2 facilities together account for 4.6 MW total, meaning this campus represents exactly half of that published total. Most Maryland facilities in the map carry no published capacity figure at all, so the state picture is incomplete. Maryland does not emerge from this data as a significant AI compute hub, and this campus, while the largest published facility in the state by this site's records, is not at a scale that would register as a material node in AI training infrastructure.
